points.why: The answer says a close fit doesn't show the model is right, that six parameters can fit almost any curve, and that the fit may come from compensating errors in a structure the reorg will change.
It checks each parameter against observable HR data but never reviews the causal links with the people who work there or with independent reviewers.
It runs sensitivity on the parameters the reorg touches but never sets in advance what result would prove the plan wrong.
